# GPU Compositing for Smooth Animations

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## GPU Compositing for Smooth Animations

willChange: 'width' is a CSS performance hint. It tells the browser: "this property will change soon - prepare a separate compositor layer for it."

Without willChange, the browser handles the sidebar width change during the main thread's layout phase. This can cause a visible stutter or "flicker" when other components are re-rendering at the same time - which happens constantly in a live data dashboard like SpeedBlip.

With willChange: 'width', the browser moves the sidebar to the GPU and handles the animation on the compositing layer, completely separate from the main thread's rendering work. The sidebar slides smoothly regardless of what is happening with charts, gauges, or data updates elsewhere in the app.
